```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(lsa)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(ggrepel)
library(GGally)
library(grid)
library(colorspace)

rm(list = ls())

cat2_levels <- c("nouns", "verbs", "adjectives", "function_words", "other")

target_dir <- here("Data_vaesampled_2025Dec19")

d <- read_csv(here(target_dir, "long_data.csv")) %>% 
  rename(Nominality = `Right-Left`,
         Commonality = `Out-In`,
         Name = name) %>% 
  mutate(Name = case_when(Name == "debRoy" ~ "Roy et al. (2015)", TRUE ~ Name),
         Name = factor(Name, levels = c("Sam", "Alice", "Asa", "Roy et al. (2015)")),
         Nominality = - Nominality)
```

```{r}
make_smooth_path <- function(df, spar = 0.55, n = 100) {
  df <- df %>% arrange(AgeM)

  age_grid <- seq(min(df$AgeM), max(df$AgeM), length.out = n)

  sx <- smooth.spline(df$AgeM, df$Nominality, spar = spar)
  sy <- smooth.spline(df$AgeM, df$Commonality, spar = spar)

  tibble(
    AgeM = age_grid,
    Nominality = predict(sx, age_grid)$y,
    Commonality = predict(sy, age_grid)$y
  )
}

cols_child <- c(
  "Sam" = "#8A6FA6",   
  "Alice" = "#B07A2A",          
  "Asa" = "#B85C5C",            
  "Roy et al. (2015)" = "#3E8F6B")

shapes_child <- c(
  "Sam" = 16,
  "Alice" = 15,
  "Asa" = 17,
  "Roy et al. (2015)" = 18)
```

```{r}
d_smooth <- d %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  group_modify(~ make_smooth_path(.x, spar = 0.52)) %>%
  ungroup()

d <- d %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  mutate(
    Age_scaled = (AgeM - min(AgeM)) / (max(AgeM) - min(AgeM)),
    col_age = colorspace::lighten(cols_child[Name], amount = 0.65 * (1 - Age_scaled)),
    panel = case_when(Name %in% c("Sam", "Asa") ~ "Sam / Asa", TRUE ~ "Alice / Roy et al. (2015)")) %>%
  ungroup()

d_smooth <- d_smooth %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  mutate(
    Age_scaled = (AgeM - min(AgeM)) / (max(AgeM) - min(AgeM)),
    col_age = colorspace::lighten(cols_child[Name], amount = 0.65 * (1 - Age_scaled)),
    panel = case_when(Name %in% c("Sam", "Asa") ~ "Sam / Asa", TRUE ~ "Alice / Roy et al. (2015)")) %>%
  ungroup()

d_raw_path <- d %>% arrange(Name, AgeM)

d_seg <- d_smooth %>%
  arrange(Name, AgeM) %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  mutate(
    xend = lead(Nominality),
    yend = lead(Commonality),
    col_mid = lead(col_age),
    panel = case_when(Name %in% c("Sam", "Asa") ~ "Sam / Asa", TRUE ~ "Alice / Roy et al. (2015)")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(xend)) %>%
  ungroup()

d_arrow <- d_seg %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(panel = case_when(Name %in% c("Sam", "Asa") ~ "Sam / Asa", TRUE ~ "Alice / Roy et al. (2015)"))

label_ages <- d %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  summarise(
    age_start = min(AgeM),
    age_mid   = round(median(AgeM)),
    age_end   = max(AgeM),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("age_"),
    names_to = "label_type",
    values_to = "AgeM_target")

d_lab <- d_smooth %>%
  inner_join(label_ages, by = "Name", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  group_by(Name, label_type) %>%
  slice_min(abs(AgeM - AgeM_target), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Age_lab = paste0(round(AgeM_target), " mo"),
         panel = case_when(Name %in% c("Sam", "Asa") ~ "Sam / Asa", TRUE ~ "Alice / Roy et al. (2015)"))
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_path(
    data = d_raw_path,
    aes(x = Commonality, y = Nominality, group = Name),
    colour = d_raw_path$col_age,
    linewidth = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.30,
    lineend = "round",
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(
    data = d_arrow,
    aes(
      x = Commonality, y = Nominality,
      xend = yend, yend = xend),
    colour = d_arrow$col_mid,
    linewidth = 2.5,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm"), angle = 30, type = "closed"),
    lineend = "round",
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(
    data = d_seg,
    aes(
      x = Commonality, y = Nominality,
      xend = yend, yend = xend),
    colour = d_seg$col_mid,
    linewidth = 2.6,
    alpha = 0.95,
    lineend = "round",
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(
    data = d,
    aes(x = Commonality, y = Nominality, shape = Name),
    colour = d$col_age,
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.4,
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(
    data = d %>% group_by(Name) %>% slice_tail(n = 1) %>% ungroup(),
    aes(x = Commonality, y = Nominality, colour = Name, shape = Name),
    size = 3.8,
    alpha = 0,
    show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_label_repel(
    data = d_lab,
    aes(x = Commonality, y = Nominality, label = Age_lab, colour = Name),
    fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.88),
    label.size = 0,
    label.r = unit(0.12, "lines"),
    size = 2.9,
    fontface = "bold",
    box.padding = 0.75,
    point.padding = 0.8,
    force = 18,
    force_pull = 0.02,
    segment.size = 0.25,
    segment.colour = "grey55",
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  # coord_equal() +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, nrow = 1) +
  # facet_wrap(~ Name, nrow = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Commonality (Back - Front)",
    y = "Nominality (Left - Right)") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols_child, name = "Child") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shapes_child, name = "Child") +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        alpha = 1,
        size = 4,
        shape = unname(shapes_child))),
    shape = "none") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    # legend.position = "none",
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank())

ggsave(here("Figures", "EN_06_Long_SAYR.png"), width = 10, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
# ggsave(here("Figures", "EN_06_Long_SAYR.png"), width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
